policy.braid: Verified braid diameter and length only
policy.selection: Nearest proportional eligible same-material diameter; deterministic evidence-ID tie break
policy.formula: source length * (source diameter / selected line diameter)^2, with consistent units
policy.fallback: Existing capacity and backing behavior when no usable same-material diameter reference exists
policy.backing: Existing dual-anchor fraction calculation using the appropriate full-spool capacity for each line

verification.source: Previous audits and reviewed physical evidence, checked against frozen identities, source decisions, original values and hashes; not a fresh reinspection of every manufacturer page or photo
verification.unit_regression_browser_fixture: All checks passed, including repeated metric/standard switching, custom and database line, capacity and backing

limits: Correct source selection and formula parity do not establish measured real-world accuracy for every reel/line combination.

Printed ratings and line diameters can be rounded. When multiple ratings imply different spool volumes, nearest-reference selection can change estimates at reference boundaries; no averaging or interpolation is introduced.
Existing braid planning ranges remain heuristic, not newly validated confidence bounds.
Selected-line inch values and existing inch/metric rounding behavior are unchanged.
Unclassified, uncertain exact-model, source-conflicted and unreviewed photo evidence remains stored but calculation-ineligible.
Do not activate the old experimental resolver switch.

release.authorized_scope: Publish verified same-material manufacturer diameter preference in capacity and backing calculations; no mono-median change
release.local_unit_browser_recheck: All checks passed after release version updates
